canonical_title: Biohub Virtual Biology Initiative expands to $1.8B with US government and AI-lab partners
aliases: Google DeepMind Isomorphic Labs Meta Biohub
treatment: Covered as a new ledger topic because the April $500M Biohub initiative gained material new named commitments on Oct 7, bringing the effort to $1.8B. Reinclude only for new named funders/commitments, dataset release, predictive-model release, access-policy change, or material technical results.
known_facts: On Oct 7, the U.S. Department of Energy committed more than $500M over five years; NIH will coordinate and standardize datasets built with more than $500M in prior federal funding; Meta, Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs jointly committed $300M.
The first dataset is targeted in about one year and predictive cell models within five years.
Commercial funders receive an embargo/head-start period before funded datasets become public; government-funded work has no such restriction.
reinclude_only_if: New named funding or partner commitment materially changes scale.
A first dataset or predictive model is actually released.
Material change to open-data/embargo access terms.
Reproducible technical results materially change expected utility.
notes: Night-window hard delta: Reuters published 2026-10-07 13:02 UTC (22:02 JST).
